pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown polygonal patches with rounded vertices. Edge gradients are smooth on the lower flank but transition to sharper angularity in the patches situated on the upper neck and shoulder region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-nodal (Y-shaped intersections) with a relatively uniform pixel thickness throughout the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the dorsal neck ridge displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D profile against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of five dark avian figures (oxpeckers) attached to the giraffe's pelage: two on the upper neck ridge, one on the mid-shoulder, one on the central flank, and one on the posterior/tail-base region.
